title: Top 5 STRANGEST Signals From Space
hook: Number one, for 72 seconds in 1977 something screamed across the radio spectrum, then vanished forever.

items.name: Fast Radio Burst FRB 121102
items.stat: Repeating millisecond bursts releasing more energy than the Sun does in a whole day.

items.name: Pulsar PSR B1919+21
items.stat: Ticks every 1.337 seconds so precisely it was first nicknamed LGM-1 for 'Little Green Men'.

items.name: Tabby's Star (KIC 8462852)
items.stat: Dips in brightness up to 22% baffled scientists and sparked alien megastructure theories.

items.name: The Cosmic Microwave Background
items.stat: The oldest signal in existence, a faint 2.7 Kelvin glow left over from 380,000 years after the Big Bang.

items.name: The Wow! Signal
items.stat: A 72-second radio blast detected in 1977 that has never been heard again.
items.query: Big Ear radio telescope Wow signal
